reporting-org.narrative: IHE Delft Institute for Water Education

title.narrative: DGIS - IHE Delft Programmatic Cooperation (DUPC), 2021-2027

description.narrative: The third phase of the Water and Development Partnership Programme focuses on stimulating and catalysing transformations to socially inclusive and ecologically sustainable water management practices. The programme aims to achieve this by strengthening capacities in non-European, low- and middle-income countries through joint research, education, and knowledge sharing within inter- and transdisciplinary projects on actual water challenges.
